description_en: Returns a paginated list of Live Snapshot templates
description_zh: 调用ListLiveSnapshotTemplates获取实时截图模板列表，可分页获取
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-live-snapshot-templates --search-key-word 0000a046-263c-3560-978a-fb2877820000 --template-ids 0000a046-263c-3560-978a-fb2877820000 --type custom --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveSnapshotTemplates

parameters.help_en:
The search keyword. You can perform a fuzzy search by template ID or template name.

Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh:
搜索关键词，模板ID/名称，名称支持模糊搜索。
最大长度为128
parameters.name: search_key_word

parameters.help_en:
The template IDs.

This parameter does not take effect if `SearchKeyWord` is specified.

You can specify a maximum of 200 template IDs
parameters.help_zh:
指定模板ID查询。
如果指定SearchKeyWord，该条件不生效。
数组长度最大为200
parameters.name: template_ids

parameters.help_en: The type of the template. By default, templates of all types are queried
parameters.help_zh: 模板类型，默认是查询全部
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The sorting method. By default, results are sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序，默认按CreateTime排序，默认是desc
parameters.name: sort_by
